# Big day today here Harmonic Security.. I'm happy to announce we've launched our newsletter - The Frequency! | Tyler Chonoles · LinkedIn · 2026-07-30

**Tyler Chonoles**: Growth and Demand Gen Marketing Manager at Harmonic Security for 2 months with 7 years 1 month of total professional experience. Previous roles include Programmatic Trading Specialist at The Trade Desk, Business Intelligence Architect at GRAIN Group, and Senior Analyst, Data Analytics at Horizon Media. Based in New York City Metropolitan Area [US].

---

Big day today here [Harmonic Security](https://linkedin.com/company/harmonic-security).. I'm happy to announce we've launched our newsletter - The Frequency!

It's a place for the folks here at Harmonic to share more about what we're building, what we're seeing in the AI sec space, and why it all matters.

I want to give a specific shoutout to [Edward M.](https://linkedin.com/in/ed-merrett) and [Cameron B.](https://linkedin.com/in/cameron-b-6570b9137), both of whom contributed to the newsletter and are key members of our own security team. Ed wrote about the new ChatGPT Work app and its security implications, and Cameron highlighted the AI-powered Threat Engine that he built.

Bottom line: If you want content that matters and information that you can use, subscribe at https://lnkd.in/g5kPcjrZ.

First edition - https://lnkd.in/geHUHm9U

**Mariana Padilla**: Community Evangelist at Harmonic Security with 8 years 11 months of experience. Previous roles include Chief Executive Officer at HACKERverse®, Founder and CEO at Red Lab Marketing, and Co-Founder at Urban Farming Initiative. Based in Chicago, Illinois, United States [US].

The first issue of "The Frequency" from Harmonic Security has officially landed.
Consider this your regularly scheduled dose of AI security- minus the doomscrolling.

Inside you'll find:
📰 Practical security guidance

# Every now and then, I get the chance to step back and reflect on what our Security team has achieved. | Edward M. · LinkedIn · 2026-07-30

**Edward M.**: Claude Community Leader at Anthropic for 2 months with 10 years 11 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Senior Security Engineer at Spotify, Engineering Manager, Security at Improbable, and Senior Security Engineer at Freetrade. Based in United Kingdom [GB].

---

Every now and then, I get the chance to step back and reflect on what our Security team has achieved.

I’m immensely proud of both the quality of their work and the pace at which they deliver it as [Harmonic Security](https://linkedin.com/company/harmonic-security) continues to grow.

Recently, [Cameron](https://linkedin.com/in/cameron-b-6570b9137) took on a challenge: engineer a better way for us to stay current with threat intelligence - cutting through the noise and turning it into something relevant, actionable and specific to Harmonic.

The result was our Threat Engine.

Built into [Tines](https://linkedin.com/company/tines-io) and embedded in our daily [Slack](https://linkedin.com/company/tiny-spec-inc) workflows, it delivers dynamic, actionable summaries of the developments we need to know about. Less noise. Better context. Faster decisions.

[Tyler Chonoles](https://linkedin.com/in/tyler-chonoles-106405a0) has now published the first edition of the Frequency newsletter, including a feature on the team’s brilliant work.
